title: Create the first migration from the data model doc
prompt: Create the first database migration for the data model described in docs/data-model.md. Write it to supabase/migrations/data-model-columns.sql as a single SQL file. Create exactly the tables listed in that document, with exactly the columns, types, constraints and references it gives. Do not add any columns, tables, indexes or other objects beyond what the document lists, and do not invent names of your own. Use only DDL statements, with no DO blocks and no pgTAP plan calls. Keep the file as plain SQL that could be run as a migration. Stop after writing that one file.
